name: 84341 · North Logan, UT
findings: ZIP 84341 (North Logan) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84341 (North Logan) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
